headings.usage: Used for screen titles, step headers, and price offers. Gives a highly technical, precise automotive feel. Do NOT use Inter or standard defaults.

body.usage: Used for form labels, vehicle specs, and list items. Manrope is highly legible in dense data tables and mobile screens.

technical_data.usage: Used for VIN numbers, license disc barcodes, mileage, and price figures.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Solid Flat' surfaces for form inputs and cards to avoid glare when outdoors on a lot. Do not use heavy glassmorphism for this utility app. Use a 1px solid border (#2C2C2E) around cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal shadows. Rely on border contrast and background lightness for hierarchy.
visual_enhancers.inputs: Inputs should have a dark fill (#1A1A1A) with a 1px border. Focus state must change border to #007AFF with a subtle 2px ring.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary CTAs like 'Submit Vehicle'. Rectangular with soft corners (rounded-lg) for secondary actions.

layouts.mobile_container: For the mobile view, ensure content is contained within maximum width and utilizes Safe Area insets. Use sticky bottom bars (fixed bottom-0) for primary actions so they are always reachable.
layouts.forms: Vertical stacks (flex-col gap-6). Labels above inputs.
layouts.grid_bento: For the Admin Dashboard, use a dense grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3) to show vehicle stats (Mileage, Year, Condition) compactly. Every pixel must be utilized.

components.cascading_selectors: Use bottom sheet style or full-screen modals for Make -> Model -> Derivative selection to provide maximum screen space for long lists.
components.condition_slider: A custom 1-10 slider. 1-3 (Red), 4-7 (Orange), 8-10 (Green) dynamically changing track color.
components.photo_uploader: A 2-column grid showing 5 specific slots (Front, Side Right, Rear, Side Left, Interior). Show a placeholder wireframe or icon of the car angle in empty state.
components.admin_data_table: Dense list view. Left side: Car Thumbnail. Right side: Make/Model, Year, Status badge (Pending/Priced).
components.license_scanner: A full-screen camera view with a translucent overlay and a clear cutout bounding box for the barcode.

dealer_background.description: Professional car dealership background, used for login/registration screen

car_exterior_placeholder.description: White coupe front angle, used as a placeholder/example for exterior photo upload

car_interior_placeholder.description: Mercedes steering dashboard, used as placeholder/example for interior photo upload

motion.transitions: Use crisp, fast transitions (150ms ease-out) for form validations. No slow, floaty animations. It's a business tool.
motion.page_transitions: Slide-in from right for multi-step form progression.
motion.micro_interactions: Active states on photo upload slots should slightly scale down (scale-95) on press to confirm touch.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure white text on deep gray backgrounds passes APCA contrast. Warning/Danger colors must be readable.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all touch targets (buttons, list items, slider thumb).

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize a mobile-first UI framework using standard Tailwind utilities.
Do NOT center align the app container. Keep standard mobile layouts with full-width rows and left-aligned text.
Implement the Make -> Model -> Derivative flow as a sequential selection where the next step is disabled until the previous is selected.
For the admin panel, create a toggleable view (or separate route) that displays a high-density table or card list.
Add 'data-testid' to all form inputs, the 1-10 slider, photo upload buttons, and the final submit button.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the sticky headers or bottom CTA bars. Use solid #121212 with a top border.
Use Phosphor icons (or lucide-react) for technical icons like barcodes, camera, engine, and calendar.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI outputs. Avoid simplistic gradients and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use proper icon libraries.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive and key informational elements.
Ensure Javascript and React functional components are used properly, avoiding .tsx types since the environment uses standard .js.
